parameters.query:
WITH job AS (
  SELECT j.id, COALESCE(j.approval_policy,'full_staged') AS approval_policy, j.client_profile_id, j.requested_outputs,
         cp.client_code, cp.client_name, cp.preferred_tone, cp.industry, cp.compliance_notes,
         cp.brand_voice, cp.tone_rules, cp.approved_claims, cp.forbidden_claims, cp.product_families,
         cp.output_defaults, cp.default_approval_policy, cp.asset_roots, cp.delivery_preferences
  FROM content_jobs j
  LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.id=j.client_profile_id
  WHERE j.id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid
), client_profile AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN client_profile_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'id', client_profile_id,
    'client_code', client_code,
    'client_name', client_name,
    'preferred_tone', preferred_tone,
    'industry', industry,
    'compliance_notes', compliance_notes,
    'brand_voice', brand_voice,
    'tone_rules', tone_rules,
    'approved_claims', approved_claims,
    'forbidden_claims', forbidden_claims,
    'product_families', product_families,
    'output_defaults', output_defaults,
    'default_approval_policy', default_approval_policy,
    'asset_roots', asset_roots,
    'delivery_preferences', delivery_preferences
  ) END AS profile FROM job
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT approval_policy FROM job) IN ('none','qa_only','operator_final') THEN true
    ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=(SELECT id FROM job) AND approval_stage='analysis' AND decision='approved')
  END AS allowed,
  '{{$json.job_id}}' AS job_id,
  '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode,
  ('{{$json.mode}}'='live') AS live_mode,
  (SELECT approval_policy FROM job) AS approval_policy,
  (SELECT requested_outputs::text FROM job) AS requested_outputs_json,
  (SELECT profile::text FROM client_profile) AS client_profile_json;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model:($json.llm_model || "gpt-4o-mini"), messages:[{role:'system',content:"You are the planning engine for a modular AI content production system. You may only select tools from the provided available_tools registry. Do not invent tools. If a needed capability does not exist, add it to missing_capabilities. Prefer the smallest safe tool set that can complete the job. Respect client profile rules and approval policy. Return strict JSON only with job_type, summary, selected_tools, execution_order, required_inputs, missing_inputs, missing_capabilities, approval_policy, estimated_outputs, risks, and planner_reasoning."},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify($json)}], response_format:{type:'json_object'}} }}

parameters.query:
WITH warning_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_errors (job_id, severity, error_code, error_message, recoverable, context)
  SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, 'warning', 'CONTENT_PLAN_PARSE_WARNING', COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.warning_message_sql}}',''),'LLM response parse warning'), true, jsonb_build_object('raw_text', LEFT('{{$json.raw_model_text_sql}}', 2000), 'workflow', '{{$json.current_stage_sql}}')
  WHERE COALESCE('{{$json.parse_warning}}','false') = 'true'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, '{{$json.content_plan_json_b64}}' AS content_plan_json_b64, '{{$json.content_plan_json_sql}}' AS content_plan_json_sql;

WITH plan_source AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode('{{$json.content_plan_json_b64}}','base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb AS plan_json
), output_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id, output_type, title, structured_data, qa_status)
  VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, 'tool_execution_plan', 'Tool execution plan', (SELECT plan_json FROM plan_source), 'pending')
  RETURNING id, structured_data
), plan_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_job_tool_plans (job_id, source_output_id, selected_tools, execution_order, missing_inputs, missing_capabilities, approval_policy, plan_payload, status)
  SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,
         id,
         COALESCE(structured_data->'selected_tools','[]'::jsonb),
         COALESCE(structured_data->'execution_order','[]'::jsonb),
         COALESCE(structured_data->'missing_inputs','[]'::jsonb),
         COALESCE(structured_data->'missing_capabilities','[]'::jsonb),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(structured_data->>'approval_policy',''),'full_staged'),
         structured_data,
         'active'
  FROM output_insert
  RETURNING id
), job_update AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs SET status='waiting_for_plan_approval', approval_policy=COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT plan_json->>'approval_policy' FROM plan_source),''), content_jobs.approval_policy, 'full_staged'), updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid RETURNING id
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'approval_gate','Tool execution plan approval gate reached',jsonb_build_object('approval_stage','plan','output_type','tool_execution_plan','plan_id',(SELECT id FROM plan_insert)))
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, 'waiting_for_plan_approval' AS status, (SELECT id::text FROM plan_insert) AS plan_id;
